name: Triage unassigned tasks
description: Routes new unassigned tasks to the right agent. When a root task is created without an assignee, the project's assignable agents are scored against the task by a small LLM rubric: high-confidence matches are auto-assigned (which starts the normal agent execution loop); everything else gets a suggestion comment so a human decides. Decomposition subtasks (which have a parent) and pre-assigned tasks are ignored. Tune the confidence bar in the 'confident' step or deactivate the trigger in Automations.

en.name: Triage unassigned tasks
en.description: Scores assignable agents against a new unassigned task and either auto-assigns the best match or leaves a suggestion comment.

config.description: Pre-assigned tasks already have an owner; subtasks were just placed by a decomposing manager; anything else is not triage's business.

config.name: Task triage scorer

slug.description: The best-matching agent slug, exactly as it appears in the candidate list.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how confident you are this agent should own the task.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the match (shown to humans).

config.systemPrompt: You route project-board tasks to AI agents. Pick the single best agent for the task from the candidate list using their descriptions; prefer candidates marked preferred. Score conservatively: use confidence above 0.7 only when the task clearly falls inside one agent's specialty; use a low confidence when several agents fit equally, the task is ambiguous, or it likely needs a human. Reply with the JSON object only.

config.description: A human (or an agent claim) may have assigned the task while scoring ran — their choice wins.
The auto-assign bar. Lower it for more automation, raise it for more human routing.

steps.name: Assign the agent (starts the execution loop)

parameters.body: [automated] 💡 Assignment suggestion: {{steps.score.output.data.slug}} (confidence {{steps.score.output.data.confidence}}) — {{steps.score.output.data.reason}} Assign from the board to start work.
